questions.stem: Should statins be stopped around surgery in a patient with hyperlipidaemia?
options: Yes, stop on the morning of surgery
Only stop if liver tests are raised

questions.stem: How should hyperlipidaemia be regarded in anaesthetic assessment?
options: As a renal failure risk factor
As a contraindication to all surgery
As an ischaemic heart disease risk factor
As a cause of airway obstruction

questions.stem: When should a patient already taking statins continue them?
options: Only in the first 24 hours after surgery
